item.title: Complaint: A Cancelled Flight
item.prompt_text: Your flight from Istanbul to Tashkent was cancelled only two hours before departure. Airline staff gave no clear information, no hotel was offered, and you had to pay for a hotel and a new ticket yourself. You also missed an important day at work. Write a formal letter of complaint to the airline's customer relations department.
item.target_grammar: formal passives (I was informed…, no assistance was offered); inversion for emphasis (Not only…)
item.target_structure: purpose and booking details + account of events + criticism of how it was handled + consequences + specific demands + firm closing

checklist.point: State the purpose and give the flight details
Explain what happened and how badly it was handled
State clearly what you expect the airline to do
Refer to evidence and close firmly but politely
